results: A shared proper-metric sphere-in-open-set theorem constructs an actual closed annular collar. Banach-algebra circle integration is continuous in arbitrary parameters. Fubini and the actual resolvent identity prove the nested-circle product formula; Cauchy on the collar proves that the normalized circle integral is idempotent.

Operator-norm circle integrals of compact operators are compact, using the closed submodule of compact operators and an actual integral in that complete submodule. A compact bounded idempotent has finite-dimensional range. No finite-rank projection is assumed as input.

Original H-minus-one multiplication depends bounded-linearly on its potential in operator norm. The actual normalized physical pencil and its entire H1/H-minus-one inverse are jointly norm analytic in the original potential and spectral parameter on the full physical resolvent.

PseudomeasureRieszProjection defines the actual operator-valued circle integral on the original H-minus-one base space, with the required negative sign converting the existing(L-z)inverse to(z-L)orientation. Every circle in the full physical resolvent gives a compact idempotent with finite-dimensional range.

The actual projection fixes every physical original-H1 eigenvector whose value is inside the circle and annihilates every physical eigenvector whose value is outside the closed disk. These statements reuse the actual full-domain scalar resolvent action.

Actual singular Riesz projections depend continuously in operator norm along any continuous endpoint potential family with a common physical resolvent circle. Their actual finite rank is constant on every such preconnected family, using the shared verified ProjectionRank theorem.

One central diameter circle, with left endpoint-B-1 and right endpoint pi^2*N^2-12N, lies in the full original physical resolvent for every native real source potential on the given original norm ball. Its interior cuts the actual real spectrum at exactly the existing central finite spectral set.
